title: New Batch Admission Open for Malaysia PDOT Cluster Program
description: Sangam Management Service announces the commencement of registration for the upcoming Malaysia PDOT Cluster Program batch. The 2-day compulsory pre-departure orientation covers Malaysian employment laws, workplace safety protocols, labor rights, and cultural adaptation. Prospective migrant workers are requested to visit our Tinkune office with their passport copy and preliminary labor permit documents to secure a seat. Morning shift starts daily at 7:00 AM.
